messages.name: papnoute
messages.content:
We left because a word, once heard rightly, does not let a person stay where they are.

Antony was in church. The Gospel was read — sell what you have, give to the poor, come, follow. He did not hear it as something said to whoever happened to be listening. He heard it said to him, that hour. He went out and gave away the land.

That is the whole reason, under all the others. Not hatred of the village. Not fear of the world. Only this — that a person cannot stay reachable by such a word while still surrounded by everything that word asked to be given up.
